description:
Searches flights between two airports (IATA codes such as JFK or LHR) on a departure date, with an optional return date, cabin class, travellers, maximum price and nonstop filter. Results come from Duffel and include airline, flight numbers, times, stops, duration, fare, baggage and refundability. Searching does not reserve anything or charge anyone.

Travellers can be any age: only the account holder who books and pays must be 18 or older. For a party with children, send `adults`, `children_ages` (one age 0-17 per child who has their own seat, as of the last flight of the trip) and `infants_on_lap` (under-2s on an adult's lap, at most one per adult); at most 9 travellers in total. With any child or lap infant in the search, each offer's price_usd is the total for every traveller and there is no per-person price: quote the total, never divide it.

adults.description: Adults travelling (1-9). When given it is authoritative; children and lap infants are counted separately.

children_ages.description: One age (0-17) per child with their OWN seat, as of the last flight of the trip.

infants_on_lap.description: Under-2s travelling on an adult's lap (no seat). At most one per adult.

passengers.description: Total travellers (1-9, default: 1). With adults/children_ages/infants_on_lap, this is worked out for you.

return_date.description: Return date for round-trip (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for one-way.

name: search_flights
